findings.issue: FF-NAV-MAP rule text states «new model id set == current id set» but the new model introduces a new nav entry id='reference' (paths to /rights/criticality) that is absent from the original 19 ids. The rule mentions only 'notifications' as a known carve-out, making the text technically false. The design intent is correct and documented in §3.3 and §5, but the FF assertion as worded would red-flag a well-formed implementation.
findings.suggestion: Amend FF-NAV-MAP rule to read: «…ничего не потеряно/не задвоено сверх сознательного быстрого-доступа notifications И новой группирующей точки входа reference (→ /rights/criticality)».

findings.issue: The shell.jsx sub-tab trigger (line 770) is hard-coded to screen==='rights'. After rezoning, the new 'reference' nav item navigates to /rights/criticality, so both nav contexts ('rights' and 'reference') land inside the /rights/* route family. The design correctly delegates the filtration choice to the implementer (genre-field or two arrays), but does not explicitly state which screen-id will trigger sub-tab rendering for the reference entry. This could lead to the implementer omitting the sub-tab bar when entering via 'reference'.
findings.suggestion: Add one sentence to §5.3: «Шелл показывает суб-таб-бар для screen ∈ {rights, reference}; при rights — фильтр access-жанр; при reference — фильтр reference-жанр.»

findings.issue: The referential 'rights' nav item is relabeled from «Права и доступ» to «Доступ» in the new model. This is a correct UX label change (shorter, scope-accurate after reference tabs move out). However the contract does not explicitly call out this label change — a reader comparing old label to new might mistake it for a missing item or inconsistency.
findings.suggestion: Add a parenthetical to contracts[1] or §3.3 row 9: «ярлык меняется с «Права и доступ» → «Доступ» (scope сужен после выноса справочников в 'reference')».

findings.location: design §3.4 ZONES[1] constructor items, forms entry
findings.issue: The design marks 'forms' with status:'demo' in §3.4, but in the current nav-config.js the forms item already has status:'demo' AND hidden:true. The design §3.3 row 2 correctly preserves hidden:true, but the §3.4 reference snippet omits status:'live'/'demo' disambiguation context — it simply says status:'demo'. This is consistent with source. Minor: the comment in §3.3 says «остаётся hidden:true; маршрут /forms жив» which is accurate. No actual defect.

The account popover spec lists 'Сменить организацию' as live/honest-disabled; however the current codebase has no multi-tenant switcher logic and docs describe silo-only deploy today. The design correctly marks it honest-disabled when 1 org, but the ci_check for FF-UX-DEAD must validate that honest-disabled is shown (not a broken enabled button). The FF-UX-DEAD ci_check (ux-g1-no-dead-nav.sh) should cover this, but it is a static shell check that may not reach the popover DOM without a running e2e fixture.
findings.suggestion: Consider adding honest-disabled popover coverage to nav-ia.ux.journey.ts (the e2e journey already listed for FF-UX-CONTRAST) rather than relying solely on static shell grep.
